desc.zh: 从三桶液体的等待实验，推导可区分结果的乘法与最少小猪数。
desc.en: Build a feeding schedule, count distinguishable outcomes, and derive the minimum pigs.

complexity: O(1 + log_(R+1) buckets) arithmetic time; O(1) auxiliary words, R = floor(minutesToTest / minutesToDie)

concepts.name: Outcome capacity
concepts.description: Derive the matching counting bound and feeding construction.

concepts.name: Reversible feeding schedule
concepts.description: Observe death rounds and retain consistent bucket candidates.
